source_excerpts.text:
Jam release is a separate strength problem

Removing the structural keeper simplifies recovery, but transfers the full jam-release transient into the replacement.

Conservative full-stock screen	Face	Moment strut
Coherent release energy	2.852 J	3.274 J
Additional translation bound	0.315 mm	0.294 mm
Primary force upper screen	23.66 kN	29.61 kN
Primary moment upper screen	2.516 kNm	3.548 kNm
Within proposed 30 kN / 3.5 kNm internal screen	Yes	No

Exceeding this conservative screen does not prove that the hardware will fail. It means the current calculation does not certify the proposed rating.

The cage also has two separate requirements: a structural retention screen and a bounded energy-absorption response. A 12 kN retention proof would not establish the modeled desired peak near 3 kN. The proposed bending tabs need an actual force–displacement and retained-head test.
